::: {#exm-tensor}

#### The digits at three sizes

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
print(images.ndim, images[0].ndim, images[0, 3].ndim, images[0, 3, 4].ndim)
print(images[0, 3])
print(images[0, 3, 4])
```

`images` from @sol-load-tensor has three dimensions:
image, row and column.
Indexing it once, as `images[0]`, gives the first image, a matrix;
indexing twice, as `images[0, 3]`, gives that image's row 3, a vector of 8 pixels;
and indexing three times, as `images[0, 3, 4]`, gives one pixel, a scalar,
with rows and columns counted from 0.

:::
